verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only asynchronous batch transcription jobs that are submitted once, processed in the background, and can notify a webhook when they finish. There is no documented way to configure standing automations, such as recurring schedules, event triggers like auto-transcribing new bucket files, or autonomous multi-step workflows. A one-off async job is an adjacent capability, not a recurring or triggered automation, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
